thread:
lina: prepping Mosaic release (v3.2.1) 00 change window. Order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Quick preflight thumbs?

tom: runtime build ready (runtime:v3.2.1-rc1). minor batching tweak + KV TTL defaults. I want to pin runtime at canary if api is green.

jin: console has header-split flag behind feature toggle. need router to wait until we confirm console guarded. saw one header parse spike in staging yesterday.

lina: rollback criteria: any service 5xx > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 > +10% for 5m. If triggered, rollback that service and stop wave.

tom: ack. I'll set RUNTIME_KV_TTL=120m during canary to reduce eviction noise.

deploy-bot: /deploy mosaic v3.2.1 --staged --owners @lina,@tom,@jin --order api,runtime,router,console

deploy-bot: staged deploy: api:v3.2.1 staged -> OK

lina: starting api canary 10%

deploy-bot: canary started: api:v3.2.1 -> 10%

tom: runtime canary -> 10% with TTL bump

deploy-bot: runtime:v3.2.1-rc1 -> 10%

jin: console smoke: one 502 when header flag off. pushing a small guard fix now.

lina: hold router canary until console confirms hotfix. progress api/runtime to 50% only.

deploy-bot: canary update: api -> 50%, runtime -> 50%

tom: perf stable at 50%: p95 +3%, cpu +5%

jin: hotfix deployed to staging, smoke green for 20m. ready for console canary.

lina: enable router tests and start router canary -> 10%

deploy-bot: router canary started: router:v2.5.0-canary -> 10%

deploy-bot: metrics: no 5xx increase, tail latency +2%

lina: increase router to 50%

deploy-bot: router -> 50% stable

lina: once router at 50% and console smoke holds 15m, finish console -> 100% and publish release notes: "Mosaic v3.2.1: batching improvements, KV TTL tuning, console header-split behind flag. No expected downtime."

ops-lead: reminder: add header-split smoke to preflight and log rollout in tracker if all good.

deploy-bot: runtime -> 100% ; api -> 100% ; router -> 100% ; console -> 100%

lina: release complete. retro tomorrow. Thanks all. :tada:
